title: cymbopogon sennarensis
intro: Cymbopogon sennarensis, commonly known as East Indian lemongrass, is a tropical grass species that belongs to the Poaceae family. The plant is valued for its essential oil, which has been traditionally used to treat various health conditions, including fever, digestive issues, and skin problems. East Indian lemongrass oil has been reported to possess various health benefits, such as reducing inflammation, promoting relaxation, and acting as an antimicrobial agent. The bioactive constituents of Cymbopogon sennarensis include sesquiterpenes, monoterpenes, and aldehydes, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antispasmodic properties.
